$comment: CEO plan Phase 0 §4 'the law' — a seam is plug-and-play only if it has (a) one interface, (b) one config source of truth, (c) a CI conformance suite every implementation must pass. This file lists every seam that currently satisfies all three, checkably. scripts/check-seam-registry.ts (wired into ci.yml) fails the build if a listed conformance_test_path doesn't exist on disk. Adding a seam here is a claim CI enforces — see EXTENDING.md and CLAUDE.md's '100x Blueprint Foundation' section for the broader seam catalog, some of which (AnswerVerifier, CadenceStrategy, PedagogyReviewer) are documented extension points without a real implementation yet and are deliberately NOT listed here; see the Phase 0 delivery doc for that gap.

seams.name: llm-provider-adapter
seams.description: LLM provider/model registry — one adapter per provider (gemini/anthropic/openai/ollama), selected by config/providers.yaml, never hardcoded per call site.

seams.name: gate-ma-concept-graph
seams.description: The GATE-MA prerequisite concept graph — one canonical set of nodes, no hardcoded duplicate.

seams.name: prerequisite-dag
seams.description: Prerequisite-edge cycle detection — every concept graph consuming this must stay a valid DAG.

seams.name: exam-loader-stub-rule
seams.description: Exam YAML concept_id resolution — every concept_id is a real node, a declared stub, or a hard load failure.

seams.name: content-verifier
seams.description: Tier 4+ content-quality gate. pedagogyVerifier is the one real implementation today.

seams.name: curriculum-repo
seams.description: L2 Curriculum & Content seam (100x Blueprint) — per-course concept graph access.

seams.name: scorer
seams.description: L4 Assessment seam (100x Blueprint) — descriptive-grading rubric scorer.

seams.name: item-selector
seams.description: L4 Assessment seam (100x Blueprint) — proto-CAT item selection.

seams.name: teaching-policy
seams.description: L5 Teaching Policy seam (100x Blueprint) — motivation-aware modality ranking.

seams.name: readiness-engine
seams.description: L6 Readiness Engine seam (100x Blueprint) — nextBestAction() across the four-arm core loop.
